# Notes in a heading[^heading]

A claim with a short note.[^1] Another claim with a longer note.[^long]

- A list item that cites the first note again.[^1]

[^early]: A note defined before the paragraph that cites it.

This paragraph cites the early note.[^early] A restart is required.[^reboot] Labels ignore case.[^A]

[^1]: A single paragraph note.

[^long]: First paragraph of a longer note.

    Second paragraph of the longer note.

[^reboot]: Restart the service after the change.

[^a]: A lowercase definition for an uppercase reference.

[^heading]: A note referenced from a heading.
